blocks.text: 80 questions: five from each of the 16 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 90% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Intermediate Grammar, Topic by Topic. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.
